name: Plagen
description: Plagen was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Enarc Run, with high plateaus covered in lakes and grasslands of lush yellow flora; its lowlands were dry plains.
lead_paragraphs: Plagen was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Enarc Run, with high plateaus covered in lakes and grasslands of lush yellow flora; its lowlands were dry plains.

At the junction of the Hydian Way and the Enarc Run the spaceport of TreeLeaf on the Celdas plateau is a modern city bustling with activity. The native short and furry Chikarri live in trees with spherical buildings connected by walkways.
